page.overview:
What is Cresselia?

Cresselia has a series of horns near its head that resemble crescent moons. It has a yellow stripe that stretches from its face to its tail. The rest of its body is periwinkle. It has three pink "wings", two on the side of its body and one above it that is lighter in color. They connect to two paw-like protrusions on its chest.

Prior to Generation VI, Cresselia's body style was considered to be Shape 14.

Cresselia can prevent nightmares and create sweet dreams. Those who sleep with one of its feathers will dream.

It is widely believed that Darkrai and Cresselia are enemies, but in reality, are in love. But the Abilities they both possess causes disruptions to people and Pokémon for their sleeping is disturbed from both sweet dreams and worst nightmares. Hunted for their misfortunes, this forces the two Pokémon to be forever separated except for once a year when their abilities are suppressed by the Alpha Pokémon Arceus so that both Pokémon can be given a single night together.
